findings.invariant: 0053 C15 requires a one-to-one closure among every PredecessorOutputRef, predecessor-output InputContract, EdgeSetEntry, and selected predecessor OutputContract.
findings.counterexample: Start with a valid bootstrap tuple. Add to A1 a canonically ordered second predecessor_output_ref for tape-manifest-materialization with output_name=unlinked-output and otherwise well-typed fields, but add no edge or predecessor-output contract. Recompute that ActionIntent digest, ActionIntentSet digest, Scope digest, and dependent signed PEA/BVP/CAS/admission links. The candidate accepts it: accepted_dangling_predecessor_ref=NonAuthorizingAdr0125StructuralSignaturePreflight. The existing loop validates each predecessor-output contract, and the final loop validates each edge, but neither iterates all refs to require exactly one edge/contract.
findings.consequence: A signed structural preflight can accept a DAG whose declared predecessor port has no required input or edge. That violates the approved closed-DAG/C15 adjacency contract and can hide an unbound dependency before later authority stages.
findings.disposition: open; candidate must be corrected with a regression test and both final lenses rerun
